problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $b$ shown above. If the general least-squares solution of $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]\,+\,{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}a \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}\in R,
$$

what is the value of $a-4b+c?$

feedback.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ -4 & 4\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $b$ above. If the normal equation corresponding to the system $Ax=b$ is given below, what is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ -17 & 17\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-15 \\ c\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The normal equation corresponding to $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,Ax & ={A}^{T}b \\ [\begin{aligned}1 & -4 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ -4 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}17 & -17 \\ -17 & 17\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-15 \\ 15\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=17+(-17)+15=15.
$$
